families.label: Axes
families.note: Rung order is transcribed from the source, which places Gilded above Rune. See DEC-0003.

families.label: Bars
families.note: Order is the Smithing level to smelt the bar. Silver and gold bars are crafted, not smithed.

families.label: Barronite mace and the Ancient/Imcando reward set
Gems
families.note: Cut gems. Each is also the processed half of an uncut/cut state pair.

families.label: Herbs
families.note: Clean herbs in Herblore cleaning order. Huasca, Golpar, Noxifer and Buchu leaf are left off - their position in this order is not settled here.

families.label: Necklaces
families.note: Ordered by the gem ladder. The dragonstone rung is named 'Dragon necklace' in game.

families.label: Ores
families.note: Order is Mining level. Copper and Tin share a rung - same level, same XP.

families.label: Pickaxes
families.note: Rung order is transcribed from the source, which places Gilded above Rune. That is a faithful copy, not an adopted answer to the cosmetic-tier question - DEC-0003.

families.label: Rings
families.note: Ordered by the gem ladder. Onyx ring has no card in Card.json, so it has no rung.

families.label: Runes
families.note: Order is Runecraft level. Combination runes are a components case, not a rung - Phase 7.

families.label: Shortbows
families.note: Transcribed from TheSeahorsie's page. The source also lists Magic shortbow (i) above Magic shortbow; it is not a card in Card.json, so it has no rung.
